pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition of scaling into losing positions; subsequent entries only permitted after the primary position achieves a minimum +$10.00 floating profit and shifts stop-loss to breakeven.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Zero order entry permitted unless the 14-period ATR expansion confirms directional momentum and the order book imbalance exceeds 65% in the direction of the trade.
profit_harvest_threshold: Scale out 50% of volume at +$10.00 and trail the remaining position with an aggressive volatility-adjusted step-stop to capture the full +$15.00 to +$30.00 tail.
